description.zh:
是否只查询跨账号所属的智能接入网关实例。取值：

- **false**（默认值）：否。

- **true**：是。
description.en:
Specifies whether to query only the Smart Access Gateway instances that belong to other accounts. Valid values:

- **false** (default): No.
- **true**: Yes.

description.zh:
智能接入网关实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~69813~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The ID of the region where the Smart Access Gateway instance is deployed.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~69813~~) operation to obtain the region ID.

description.zh: 智能接入网关实例所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the Smart Access Gateway instance belongs.
The ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance.

description.zh: 智能接入网关设备序列号。
description.en: The serial number (SN) of the Smart Access Gateway device.

title.zh: 获取SAG设备路由协议开启的端口列表

descriptions.zh: 目前仅设备版本为3.4.2及以上的SCG5000和SCG5000-5G设备支持获取智能接入网关设备路由协议开启的端口列表。
descriptions.en: You can query the list of ports that have a routable protocol enabled only on SCG5000 and SCG5000-5G devices of version 3.4.2 or later.
